versions.changelog: v29.1.0: Add LICENSE, fix playwright dep check, align metadata (version/author), remove dead engine docs, delete stale TEST_REPORT.md, surface differentiator (pure search + Playwright anti-bot)

Version 29.0.0

- Major version update with no user-facing or documented feature changes.
- No adjustments to usage, APIs, or installation are noted in SKILL.md.
- Internal file changes only; external behavior remains unchanged.
- Safe to upgrade with no required migration steps.

**Changelog for v28.1.1**

- Major README and SKILL.md rewrite/cleanup: clearer English docs, condensed usage and install instructions, private-by-design notes.
- All documentation now emphasizes region-aware autodetection, no runtime `npm install`, and privacy/supply-chain safety.
- Added Windows setup script (`scripts/setup.ps1`); removed redundant and legacy scripts.
- Daemon browser reuse and heartbeat process now documented; config validation clarified.
- Skill triggers updated for broader English and Chinese search phrases.
- No core logic changes outside documentation and setup scripts.

- Enhanced reliability: search/fetch now prefer HTTP, falling back to Playwright only when needed for better cross-platform compatibility.
- Playwright now defaults to headless mode and disables sandbox for improved support on servers and containers.
- Overseas (DDG) search uses Playwright request as a fallback if fetch fails, and will retry Bing if still no results.
- Improved environment checks: now verifies actual browser executables, not just the presence of the cache directory.
- Installation help updated—added troubleshooting for Playwright download interruptions and Chromium path overrides.
- SKILL.md now has a YAML frontmatter header and more detailed usage/troubleshooting sections.

Initial release of free-web-search-js, a one-step Playwright-based web search and content scraping tool, requiring no API keys.

- Supports both domestic (Bing CN via Playwright) and overseas (DDG via HTTP) search engines, auto-detecting region and using appropriate engines/strategies.
- Automatically crawls and summarizes top 3 search results after searching.
- Intelligent duplication removal based on core URLs, with Bing redirect decoding.
- Adaptive content extraction: handles API responses, JSON-LD, Next.js data, meta tags, and GBK encoding.
- Performance-optimized with optional browser daemon for faster repeated searches.
- CLI tools for both search+fetch and standalone fetching by URL.
- Includes robust region/IP detection and fallback strategies; manual override available.
